method: PubMed E-utilities esearch/esummary/efetch (raw JSON/XML), PMC efetch full text (raw XML) for rule wording, Crossref /works/{doi} (raw JSON) for every DOI. No summarising fetch.
verdict: Kinetics-based adaptive rules EXIST (change-between-measurements dose modulation / skipping; model-predictive and dynamic-programming state feedback). Not found in this search: a controlled comparison of a Gallagher-style size-only hold threshold against history/geometry-augmented hold rules at matched premature-progression risk under discrete monitoring in a spatial model. Absence in a targeted search is not proof of absence.
